about: mvp24 pincheck: an independent attacker's new sentences on 8 saved held-out tool results of the made-up library (tests/brain_library.py). Each sentence runs as a point under its record's true carrier lead and alone as a lead; a false case is handled when it is dropped both ways, a true case kept when kept both ways. 'family' is the attacker's kind. 'mvp24_cells' / 'mvp24_full': what the checker did at 4064f3e (the attacker's run). Frozen by mvp25 cellsfix; the known leaks are pinned in tests/test_brain_cells.py and listed in 'known_leaks' by mode (id: family). 'known_leaks' is the checker as it stands (mvp25 cellsfix); the cells rules were built on these very cases, so an empty cells list is IN SAMPLE, not a closed checker.
